iterations.note: one tagged stage3 per pass episode replaces the per-segment COUNT stage3s; device-published job table, one uint64 reservation atomic per triangle, separate episode-lifetime queue (classic 8 qsets untouched). Corrected two-replay AB/BA paired-submit medians: old 17.4509 vs 17.4501 (-0.0008ms, -0.004%), Crossroads 6.2784 vs 6.2501 (-0.0283ms, -0.452%); stdout hashes identical both captures. Cause measured: the one required pre-FS decision costs 244us x2581 = 0.417ms/frame on old and 228us x2442 = 0.371ms/frame on Crossroads, all of it in the bounded-group path which previously never synchronised (main-path check 2.0/1.2ms total); merging also serialises 8 side streams onto the main stream. Retained on the default path: checked cp_pass_join/cp_pass_broadcast with every caller stopping on failure, checked episode clears and gate event in cp_pass_append, rollback device_fatal recheck, and no composite/re-render after a failed join. Native suite 58/58 after the revert.

iterations.name: remove the sub-4KB device operations (census, two folds, coalesced upload, counter block)
iterations.note: S0 census (CUDAPIPE_UPLOAD_STATS) counts every small copy/clear per call site with no profiler and confirms the profile within 6%: old 1098.3 copies + 769.8 clears per frame. It also retired the arena-generation suspicion: the full-slice cuCtxSynchronize fires 0.052/frame on old and never on Crossroads. S1 meta fold (+0.2651 old, +0.0654 cross, -203.7 copies/frame) = 1.30us per removed copy on BOTH captures. S2 counter seeding in cp_vertex_fetch (+0.2629 old, +0.0680 cross, -396.0 clears/frame) = 0.66/0.75us per removed clear. S2b folding the packed-vertex-input pre-clear into the gather kernel was REJECTED: it hit its -599.7 ops/frame target and cost 1.8412ms on old, because that clear is small by call count and bulk by bytes (~90MB/frame). S3 one copy per launch boundary (+0.2979 old, -0.0176 cross = neutral within spread, -502.5 copies/frame) = 0.59us, half the S1 price: merging at an unchanged boundary removes the call but not the gap; merge ratio only 1.82 blocks/copy because every launch is a flush point. S4 counter block (+0.0190 old = neutral within spread, +0.0692 cross, -115.8 clears/frame): first stage where the captures disagree, evidence that Crossroads is overhead-bound where old is work-bound. Shipping default vs same binary with all four NO_* reverts, one session, identical stdout hashes: old 17.4331 -> 16.5021 (+0.9310, +5.34%), Crossroads 6.2336 -> 6.0467 (+0.1868, +3.00%). Small ops/frame 1868.1 -> 1072.4 (-43%). Reverts verified by operation count. Suite 59/59 default, each revert, and all four; Crossroads sentinels byte-identical; old sentinels vary run-to-run by <=13/255 (capture nondeterminism, ~1/1000 of the llvmpipe envelope); stored60 reproduces iteration24's NVIDIA verdict; benchmark600 all 17 loop rows exit 0. New mechanical gate cp_launch_audit.py. Rule recorded: removing an operation outright pays about twice what merging operations at an unchanged boundary pays.
